elderly.name: Elderly housing relief
elderly.formula: p.value * 0.005 * slider/100 if (h.age > 70 and p.is_residence) else 0
elderly.hint: 0.5% rebate on primary residence value for households 70+.

lvt.name: Land value tax
lvt.hint: Henry George style: tax on land value only (1%).

inherit.name: Inheritance leak
inherit.hint: Approximates wealth dispersion on death (0.5%/year past age 82).

income_targeted.name: Below-median ownership subsidy
income_targeted.formula: 3000 * slider/100 if (h.first_time_buyer and h.income < median_income) else 0
income_targeted.hint: €3,000 bonus for first-time buyers below median income.
